contexts.text: The thistle and the thorn () = evil and falsity vastating the goods and truths of worship. ( = that evils and falsities will enter and make Worship. AC 9714:8.)
The thorn and the thistle () = mere falsity and evil. TCR 498:2.
The thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars () = truth falsified and the derivative evil in all their worship.
